name: evn-battery-status
description: Shows EVN ALPHA battery voltage and reading age in VS Code status bar by reading from endurance log CSV (non-interfering, no serial port access)

evnBatteryStatus.csvPath.description: Path to endurance log CSV relative to workspace root

evnBatteryStatus.updateIntervalMs.description: How often to check the CSV for updates (milliseconds)

evnBatteryStatus.showCells.description: Show individual cell voltages in tooltip

evnBatteryStatus.warnAgeSeconds.description: Show warning color if reading older than this many seconds
